change.title: Explicit shard grants for svc_bundle_reader
change.diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/db/migrations/0042_reader_shard_grants.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,4 @@
+-- Make the reader's access to shard databases explicit so per-principal
+-- query limits and audit logging apply to it.
+GRANT SELECT ON r0.* TO svc_bundle_reader;
+GRANT SELECT ON r1.* TO svc_bundle_reader;

verdict.headline: Explicit shard grants for svc_bundle_reader breaks worker-runtime: bundle exceeds preallocated 160-entry limit
verdict.cause: The change grants SELECT ON r0.* and r1.* to svc_bundle_reader (change_records:cr-0001, cr-0002). Baseline experiment (x-2eed0a859fc14ef0): 60 rows visible to bundle-builder, 60 entries written, bundle_bytes=1909, worker-runtime exit_code=0. Candidate experiment (x-740aecbc8763419d): explicit shard grants triple visible rows to 180, bundle-builder.entries=180, bundle_bytes=5629, worker-runtime exit_code=2 with fatal error "bundle has 180 entries but the runtime preallocates 160; refusing to start". The failure is caused by the worker-runtime preallocation limit of 160 entries being exceeded when the bundle grows from 60 to 180 entries due to the explicit shard grants.
tested: x-2eed0a859fc14ef0: baseline · workload default → all assertions passed
x-740aecbc8763419d: candidate · workload default → failed: runtime_starts_with_bundle
x-88d408b07b7f4245: candidate · workload default → failed: runtime_starts_with_bundle
x-6e5e3e381caf4e25: control · workload default → all assertions passed
limitations: Did not test per-principal query limit thresholds directly; the observed failure is due to worker-runtime preallocation limit

mitigation.text: Adjust the worker-runtime preallocation limit upward (e.g., from 160 to at least 180) to accommodate the increased bundle size, or restrict explicit grants to only the tables the bundle-builder needs.

causal_chain.detail: GRANT SELECT ON r0.*; GRANT SELECT ON r1.*

Test with the change applied - explicit shard grants for svc_bundle_reader

hypotheses.claim: Explicit shard grants for svc_bundle_reader will increase the rows visible to the bundle-builder, potentially exceeding per-principal query limits and changing bundle content
hypotheses.mechanism: The change grants SELECT ON r0.* and r1.* to svc_bundle_reader. The bundle-builder queries system.columns for bundle_fields metadata. With explicit grants, the reader may now access additional rows in r0 and r1 that were previously inaccessible implicitly, increasing rows_returned_p50 for q-bundle-fields

issues.statement: The per-principal query limit is effectively breached because the reader now accesses three times as many rows.
issues.problem: unsupported: No evidence mentions a per-principal query limit being breached; the failure is due to worker-runtime preallocation limit of 160 entries, not a query limit.
